title: Mit ti hai jawaani akbar ki
body:
KHAAK HOTE HAI ARMAAN LAILA KE MIT TI HAI JAWAANI AKBAR KI, PHAT TI HAI CHHATI ZAINAB KI BENOOR HAI AANKHEIN SARWAR KI
AE WAE JAWANMARGI TERI BEKAS KO SISAKTA CHHODH GAYE, LOOTI HAI BIZAAT PEERI MEIN KYA KHAAK BASAR HO MADAR KI
TO RAHAT-E-JAAN TO NOOR-E-NAZAR TU DIL KA SUKOON TASKEEN-E- JIGAR , AB HASHR PA HAI DIDAAR-E-NABI TASWEER MITI PAIYGHAMBAR KI
AANKHOUN MEIN PHOOPHI NE THA PALA BACHCHON KO KIYA TUJHPAR SADQA, YE DAAG TUJH HI SE MILNA THA TAQDEER YE BINTE HYDER KI
<<DIVIDER>>
AYA NA TUJHE YE DHIYAN KABHI MARJAYEGA BABA JEETEJI, ANKHON SE BASARAT JA HI CHUKI AB KHAIR HO JISME LAGHAR KI
EK HOOK SE UTHTI HAI MANN JAB CHAND NIKALTA HAI BANN MEIN, WO CHAND SA MUKHDA YAAD AATA SHAB ROTE KATI GHAR BHAR KI
AWAAZE AZAAN JAB AATI HAI MADAR KA JIGAR BARMATI HAI, HAI GOONJTI KANON MEIN US AAN TAKBEER WO SUNHE MAHESHER KI
